summary: Today presents a regulatory and retail-focused legal briefing led by the CCPA's enforcement order against misleading consumer features and Nielsen's report on FMCG e-commerce growth. Broader market dynamics highlight corporate ESG funding commitments, inflationary pricing strategies, and major tech infrastructure investments.

bullets.text: The CCPA penalised Ola ₹10 lakh and ordered it to scrap its 'extra pay for faster rides' feature for failing to deliver.
E-commerce's share of India's FMCG retail sales tripled over the last two years, according to data released by Nielsen.
Zara parent Inditex committed $50 million to an IFC-led $400 million fund providing low-cost sustainability loans to suppliers.
Dabur India announced planned calibrated price hikes to offset margin compression caused by rising crude oil costs and inflation.
TSMC approved equity investments of up to $1 billion in AI firms OpenAI and Anthropic.
